question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` remain compatible with plus-prefixed and zero-padded decimal integers, or become a canonical-decimal-only CLI contract?
rationale: Current code accepts these spellings, public docs do not forbid them, and they resolve to the same cadence, so rejecting them is a user-facing compatibility choice rather than an established bug fix.

options.title: Preserve current grammar
options.body: Keep equivalent integer spellings accepted and close or rework this PR because no incorrect cadence or documented contract violation is established.

options.title: Adopt canonical-only grammar
options.body: Approve the breaking grammar intentionally, document the accepted form, and require supported-Node before/after/control CLI proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve current grammar
recommendation.body: Keep equivalent integer spellings accepted and close or rework this PR because no incorrect cadence or documented contract violation is established.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate connected to the Policy command and its user-facing input contract.
